title: poa nemoralis subsp. subpolaris
intro: Poa nemoralis subsp. subpolaris, commonly known as wood meadow-grass, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the genus Poa. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to support digestion and relieve stress. The therapeutic actions of Poa nemoralis subsp. subpolaris include its use as a natural anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, as well as its potential to soothe digestive issues and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other plant compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
